name: mazey-element-ui
description: A maintained Vue 2 desktop component library based on Element UI.

scripts.build:file: node build/bin/iconInit.js && node build/bin/build-entry.js && node build/bin/i18n.js
scripts.build:theme: node build/bin/gen-cssfile && gulp build --gulpfile packages/theme-chalk/gulpfile.js && cp-cli packages/theme-chalk/lib lib/theme-chalk
scripts.build:utils: cross-env BABEL_ENV=utils babel src --out-dir lib --ignore src/index.js
scripts.clean: rimraf lib dist packages/*/lib test/**/coverage examples/icon.json examples/element-ui examples/pages/en-US examples/pages/zh-CN examples/pages/es examples/pages/fr-FR
scripts.docs: npm run build:file && rimraf examples/element-ui && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node build/bin/build-docs.js && node build/bin/check-docs-assets.js && node build/bin/finalize-pages.js
scripts.dev: npm run build:file && cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack serve --config build/webpack.demo.js
scripts.dev:play: npm run build:file && cross-env NODE_ENV=development PLAY_ENV=true webpack serve --config build/webpack.demo.js
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run build:file && npm run lint && node build/bin/build-package.js && npm run build:utils && npm run build:umd && npm run build:theme
scripts.test: npm run build:theme && cross-env CI_ENV=/mazey-element-ui/ BABEL_ENV=test karma start test/unit/karma.conf.js --single-run
scripts.test:watch: npm run build:theme && cross-env BABEL_ENV=test karma start test/unit/karma.conf.js
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run test:project && npm test && npm run dist && npm run docs && npm run test:package && npm run pack:check
